name: set_selected_object_part_mask_bits

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetSelectedObjectPartMaskBits consumes two 1-based part indices and passes the selected object and both indices to func_00135868, which sets the corresponding bits in the object's part masks at offsets 0x38C and 0x390

notes: A nonpositive index leaves its corresponding mask unchanged. All eight JP calls use matching 1-based part indices: seven pass part index 2 for both masks and one additionally passes part index 3.
